verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory and context API platform, so scheduled jobs such as recurring ingestion or sync are a fair question and the axis applies. The pack only shows connectors that automatically sync via real-time webhooks, which is event-driven syncing rather than a user-defined recurring schedule, so it is adjacent behavior and earns no credit. No documented way to create, schedule or manage recurring jobs or workflows appears in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
